radargram.title: GPR radargram (two-way time, not depth)

radargram.warnings: This radargram is two-way time, not depth. Utilities, voids, archaeology, water table, and rebar are not established. A visually enhanced radargram does not have improved geological certainty.

migrated.title: GPR Kirchhoff time migration (user-velocity depth, not ground truth)
migrated.z_axis: Vertical axis is user-velocity depth (0.5 v t), not a measured depth.
migrated.warnings: Migrated depth uses the supplied velocity and is not ground truth. Utilities, voids, and archaeology are not established.

not_established: Measured depth is not established without an independently verified velocity.
